description:
🎥 4 Questions to Ask the Inspector While They’re Still on Site – Or You’ll Wish You Had Later! 🏚️➡️🏡

✅ You got the inspection done — great! But don’t stop there.
🧠 The real value is in the convo you have while the inspector is still there.

Ask these 4️⃣ game-changing questions to avoid regrets (and 💸 surprises):

1️⃣ Would YOU buy this house if you were me? 🤔
If they hesitate… pay attention. 👀

2️⃣ Which issues are URGENT ⚠️ and which ones can wait?
Not every flaw is a dealbreaker. Learn what’s safe vs. what’s just cosmetic. 🛠️

3️⃣ What would YOU negotiate if this were your deal? 🤝
Use their insight to work smarter with your agent! 💬

4️⃣ Can I walk the property with you and ask questions? 🚶‍♂️🏡
It’s like a mini homeowner’s class — don’t miss the chance to learn. 📚🔧

👉 Don’t treat your inspection like just a checklist item.
Treat it like the masterclass that could save you thousands! 💰

💬 Want an inspector who explains everything and an agent who knows what to ask?
📍In Central Texas? Message me — I’ll connect the dots for you! 🧩✨
